text:
Which of the following is not an example of convection?
A
a spoon handle becoming hot when it is placed in a hot drink
B
a thermal up-draught in the atmosphere that glider pilots use
C
flames and smoke rising from a fire
D
warming up water in a kettle on a gas ring

options.label: A
options.text: a spoon handle becoming hot when it is placed in a hot drink

options.label: B
